Like a rental deposit in escrow, this locks 240 units for 15 epochs, challengeable within 3 epochs.

Nine jurors decide within 2 epochs. Proven forgery forfeits 80%, rewards the challenger 25% of it, and bars the forger 12 epochs, like a tenant losing deposit and lease.

At scale: 1,000 fakes lock 240,000; 30% caught means 57,600 forfeited, 14,400 to challengers. A violet flag marks disputes, terms stay quartz-clear, yarrow-cheap clones fail.
